messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Do not take rosuvastatin if you:
- are allergic to rosuvastatin or any of the ingredients in your rosuvastatin tablets. See below for a complete list of ingredients.
- have liver problems.
Rosuvastatin pregnancy and breastfeeding warnings (more detail)
Triplet: ["Rosuvastatin", "has pregnancy and breastfeeding warning", "may harm an unborn baby"]

The relation 'has pregnancy and breastfeeding warning' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may pose a risk to the unborn baby or nursing infant, and patients should be advised to consult a healthcare provider.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has pregnancy or breastfeeding warning': The subject drug carries the warning specified by the object entity regarding use during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
B. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
C. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
D. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
E. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
